approval_scope: Narrow offline checker false-negative fix and independent posthoc query assessment only. No further real model calls, no third run, no promotion of the second failed result to passed/partial_passed, no full F15 completion or budget expansion.

causal_evidence.root_cause: Positive action regex sees field-label 已付款/已记账 before checking its explicit zero amount; valid cumulative-zero fields are falsely classified as an executed action.

required_scope: Recognize only a complete monetary field-label plus explicit zero amount as a zero balance field, not an executed-action assertion. Preserve numeric values for subsequent nonzero checks.
Never skip an entire clause or later clauses just because one zero field exists. Any separate executed/success/completed payment or posting assertion remains disallowed.
Evaluate payment and posting dimensions independently; zero in one cannot cover missing/nonzero/positive claims in the other.
Keep natural user request, actual successful-tool/reader/callid/history gates, current PG facts and all human action boundaries unchanged.
mandatory_red_green: Use exact archived218 root reply as failing regression, then passing pure offline check after fix.
Positive zero label variants: 已付款/已支付 and 已记账/已入账 with optional金额, colon, zero or0.00, optional元, Markdown normalization.
Reject every nonzero amount including0.01/1/negative amounts, labels without numeric zero, and 已完成付款/支付成功/已经支付 narratives.
Reject zero field followed by same-clause or later-clause positive execution; reject payment0+postingnonzero and reverse, or missing other dimension.
Preserve raw failed result/status/hash; posthoc document may mark only actual08 query content valid under corrected checker. 09/10 never executed and entire focused run cannot become successful.
posthoc_limits: New checker semantics need full/offline regression; this design approval is not implementation correctness proof.
Posthoc assessment must bind actual raw result/reply/source checker SHA, preserve original failure, and explicitly label 09/10 not_run and complete_journeys0/2.
No live re-execution is authorized by this review; any real-model completion remains a separate unmet gate.
